description: Validates a checklist or SOP definition JSON against the CHECKRUN-1 schema (definition_id, title, semver version, non-empty steps[] each with step_id/title/instruction/evidence_requirement (none|text|file-digest|attestation)/gate (blocking|advisory)). Returns valid:true/false plus a field-by-field error list. Pair with checklist_step_receipt to run the definition headlessly.
